title: Devnet native-transfer throughput (superseded)
summary: An August 2026 native-transfer flood against the live devnet, kept as an archived copy for the record. Its maintainers marked the page superseded because its figures are internally inconsistent; do not cite any number from it.

evidence_detail: The page did not record which telcoin-network commit the devnet nodes ran, and no node logs from the measurement were kept.

fleet.label: Live devnet: node1 to node5 (validator-1 to validator-4, observer-5)

methodology: The page reported a short native-transfer flood against the live devnet (chain id 32285), not a dedicated benchmark fleet.
Five load generators, each in the same cloud zone as the node it targeted, sent pre-signed EIP-1559 transfers from accounts pinned to one node each.
Throughput was counted from the blocks read back from the chain over RPC, bucketed by block-timestamp second, with the generators' block lists merged so each block counted once.
No harness manifest, raw results or node logs exist for this measurement, so none of its figures can be recomputed.
caveats: The original page carries the maintainers' notice: "Superseded — do not cite any number on this page." It explains that the page's own figures disagree with one another and that they counted foreign and reverted transactions as throughput.
Published only as an archived copy for the record. No figures from the page are republished here.

The validator and observer counts follow the instance names (validator-1 to validator-4 and observer-5). Committee membership at the time was not recorded, and the page itself calls all five nodes validators.
The disk type and size are the devnet deploy configuration's defaults at the time. The page recorded neither, nor the machine type.

modifications: Wrapped the original fragment in a complete HTML document (doctype, head, charset).
Archived copy carrying the maintainers' superseded notice; no figures from this page are republished.
